fields.name: reference_bound
fields.rule: false only before the initial accounted state has been captured

fields.name: reference_total_p
fields.rule: nonnegative; zero when reference_bound is false

accounted_total_formula: mesh_D + mesh_F + internal_D + internal_E + internal_F + structural_p + exported_p + other_exit_d + other_exit_e + other_exit_f
hard_failures: negative amount above the applicable conservation tolerance
any nonzero other_exit_d, other_exit_e, other_exit_f, or other_exit_events value
unbound reference at a required end-of-update audit
raw or negative-ID particle deletion without a complete successor map
nonperiodic out-of-domain particle loss during redistribution
orphan bond without a unique live successor or with pending material
simultaneous topology events that share a particle, bond, or destination
checkpoint field, order, identifier, or schema mismatch
later_stage_boundary: structural_p and exported_p mutations remain zero until their separately authorized P13 and P14 transactions; C08 introduces no C09-or-later behavior
claim_boundary: This schema preserves technical accounting fields but does not authorize any deferred event to remove or route state.
